correctness.rationale: For a nonempty indexed independent set, a token can move clockwise by two exactly when its next gap is at least four, and the other end of each such gap supplies the reverse-direction move. This includes the one-token case, where the gap is n; for n≥5 the two destinations differ, and moving different tokens removes different sites. Counting a distinguished occupied site counts each size-k state exactly k times, regardless of symmetry; the n anchor positions and coefficient of W^k thus give n/k and sum to the asserted derivative series. For the maximum let n=4h+r. The h long gaps consume 4h sites and leave at most one short gap. Weak compositions of r into the h gaps give the all-long terms; one short gap adds n at r=2 and n(h+1) at r=3, reproducing all residues. Every positive half-degree t≤h is realized by t long gaps with the surplus in one, and the empty state realizes zero. Each edge is oriented uniquely by the clockwise move; after fixing its 01000 five-site block the other n−5 vertices form a free path, including the empty path at n=5, giving nFₙ₋₃. Nonempty frozen sets have gaps only 2 and 3, equivalent to maximal independent sets. Independently, W(z,0)=z²+z³ and the logarithmic derivative of 1−z²−z³ gives the Perrin power sums, including their specified initial values.
